successCriteria.description: tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.service.spec.ts exists and covers: computeAvailableDays derivation (totalEntitlement - usedDays - pendingDays, never stored), negative availableDays is NOT clamped, and NegativeBalanceCounterError propagation from the repository for non-negative counter violations.

tests/unit/modules/notification/notification.service.spec.ts exists and covers: create initializing id/status='PENDING'/createdAt/readAt=null and delegating to repo.create, markRead delegating through uow.withTransaction, and findByRecipient delegating to repo.findByRecipient.

Both spec files pass under the Jest runner (npx jest) with no type errors, using jest.Mocked repository/uow mocks and fakeClient = {} as PoolClient per the existing employee.service.spec.ts conventions.

constraints: Only the two spec files may be created/modified: tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.service.spec.ts and tests/unit/modules/notification/notification.service.spec.ts. Do not modify balance.service.ts, balance.routes.ts, balance index.ts, notification.service.ts, notification.routes.ts, notification index.ts, or any repository/model file.

Test expectations must match the exact committed signatures: BalanceService(balances: PgLeaveBalanceRepository, uow: IUnitOfWork) with create/findById/findByEmployee/deduct/restore; NotificationService(notifications: PgNotificationRepository, uow: IUnitOfWork) with create/markRead/findByRecipient.
Do not reference the leave module or countLeaveDays (neither service uses it).

Follow the existing employee.service.spec.ts conventions: jest.Mocked<I...Repository> and jest.Mocked<IUnitOfWork>, uow.withTransaction.mockImplementation(async (fn) => fn(fakeClient)), construct services with mocks cast as unknown as Pg...Repository, relative imports from tests/unit/modules/... to src/modules/... and src/shared/db/unit-of-work.
outOfScope: Phase 3a deliverables (balance.service.ts, balance.routes.ts, balance index.ts) and Phase 3b deliverables (notification.service.ts, notification.routes.ts, notification index.ts) — owned by sibling sub-phases, read-only here.
Repository-level enforcement tests (assertCountersNonNegative, deduct/restore SQL guards, markRead status transition SQL) — those behaviors are tested at the repository layer, not the service layer.
The leave module and any cross-module orchestration (sufficiency/overlap checks) — Phase 4 scope.

entityInvariants.invariant: availableDays is derived (totalEntitlement - usedDays - pendingDays), never stored, and may be negative (no clamping); the three stored counters (totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays) are non-negative and a transition below zero raises NegativeBalanceCounterError.
A newly created Notification has status 'PENDING', readAt null, and a generated id/createdAt; only PENDING/SENT may transition to READ (stamping readAt), otherwise InvalidNotificationTransitionError.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Delegates to repository inside uow.withTransaction; propagates NegativeBalanceCounterError when remainingDays would drop below zero or days is negative.
Delegates to repository inside uow.withTransaction; propagates NegativeBalanceCounterError when usedDays would drop below zero or days is negative.
Delegates to repository inside uow.withTransaction; propagates InvalidNotificationTransitionError when the notification is not PENDING/SENT.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Test expectations must match the exact method signatures and constructor dependencies of BalanceService and NotificationService.
Error types asserted in tests must be the exact classes NegativeBalanceCounterError and InvalidNotificationTransitionError.
Mocking conventions (jest.Mocked, fakeClient, withTransaction mockImplementation) must match the established pattern.
The IUnitOfWork mock must expose only withTransaction<T>(fn: (client: PoolClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>.

integrationPoints.why: Unit under test for balance.service.spec.ts; its create/findById/findByEmployee/deduct/restore behavior is asserted.
Unit under test for notification.service.spec.ts; its create/markRead/findByRecipient behavior is asserted.
Injected into both services; mocked to verify deduct/restore/markRead wrap repository calls in a transaction.
